fields.why: The mean interval from procedure to death (2.8 days) is a duration of the outcome's own course, which the brief says makes an outcome continuous; but it is a minor descriptive figure, so A's omission of continuous is also defensible.

The report names an investigation and compares annual deaths across two periods (before/after) with a yearly trend figure; B's case series of 24 decedents with records is also defensible but is the investigation's own component, so A's reading adds more information.

brief_issues: The brief does not say whether a case series nested inside an outbreak investigation should also be listed as case report/series.
